site.title: Mileform · the spec-first IDE pair programmer
site.description: Mileform is an editor extension that drafts, reviews, and refactors code from a one-line intent. Spec-first, repo-aware, and silent until you ask. Works in VS Code, JetBrains, and Neovim.
site.author: Mileform Tools

props.text: Write the spec. Ship the code.

Mileform is a pair programmer that takes a one-line intent — "add a Stripe webhook for refunded charges" — and returns a full diff: handler, tests, types, and the migration. Repo-aware, spec-first, and silent until you ask. Reviews your PRs against the same spec it just wrote. No autocomplete chatter. No surprise edits.
Used by engineers at Linear, Cal.com, Replicate, and 6,800 GitHub repos · BYOK supported (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter)

props.title: Spec-first, not chat-first
props.description: You write a one-line intent. Mileform writes the spec, shows you, and waits. Approve and it generates the diff — handler, tests, types, migration. No back-and-forth, no "are you sure" prompts. The spec is the source of truth and it travels with the PR.

props.title: Repo-aware in three minutes
props.description: Point Mileform at your repo and it indexes types, conventions, test framework, and import style in under three minutes (typical 8KLOC backend). Generated code matches your existing patterns — your custom hooks, your error class, your logger — not a generic template.

props.title: Silent until you ask
props.description: No ghost text, no autocomplete chatter, no popovers stealing focus. Mileform fires only on `cmd+k`, only on your intent, and only with the diff you confirmed. The most respectful AI tool you'll ever install in your editor.

props.question: Does my code leave my machine?
props.answer: Only the slice you submit with each cmd+k call. The repo index is built locally and never uploaded. The active intent + relevant file context goes to your chosen LLM provider (BYOK on Starter and Pro). Enterprise can route through a self-hosted spec server so nothing leaves your VPC.

props.question: How is this different from Cursor or Copilot?
props.answer: Spec-first instead of completion-first. We don't fire ghost text, we don't suggest unprompted, and every generation produces a written spec that travels with the PR. If you love autocomplete, Mileform is the wrong tool. If you write small specs anyway, Mileform automates the rest.

props.question: Which languages are supported?
props.answer: First-class: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, Swift, C#. Repo-awareness works on any language with tree-sitter coverage. We're adding Elixir and Zig next quarter based on user votes.

props.question: Can I bring my own LLM key?
props.answer: Yes — Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter on every tier including Starter. Keys are stored in your OS keychain, never on our servers. Pro and Enterprise also support self-hosted gateways and can route through your existing AI proxy if you have one.
